extracted.name: Bow Matri
instruction_lines: Take a bow add maida,oil,ajwain,salt and water as required. make a soft dough. Test of 15-30 minutes
Now roll like big chapati on rolling pin and cut in square shape and pinch it in middle and give shape like a Bow.
Take a kadhai add some oil for frying after gets heat add one by one bow papdi and fry till gets brown in colour.
